Hackers spent months planning a $6 billion cryptocurrency heist. How did they get past security controls, and what can defenders learn from the attack?

This week on Security Intelligence, Seth Glasgow, Dimple Ahluwalia and Suja Viswesan join host Patrick Austin to unpack three major cybersecurity stories.

First, the Binance heist reveals how attackers exploited employees and internal systems to steal billions in cryptocurrency. The panel examines the sophisticated tactics behind the attack and what security teams can learn.

Next, Meta is using AI to catch software bugs before they reach production. As AI takes on more of the testing process, how much human oversight is enough?
